The role of well-defined nanotopography of titanium implants on osseointegration: cellular and&amp;nbsp;molecular events in vivo

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Peripheral Background only animal Exp. validation
Omar Omar, Dimitrios Karazisis, Ahmed Ballo, Šarūnas Petronis, Hossein Agheli et al. International Journal of Nanomedicine 2016-04-01 10.2147/ijn.s101294
单位: Department of Biomaterials, Institute of Clinical Sciences, Sahlgrenska Academy, University of Gothenburg, Gothenburg, Sweden; BIOMATCELL, VINN Excellence Center of Biomaterials and Cell Therapy, Goth
通讯: Omar Omar @ Department of Biomaterials, Institute of Clinical Sciences, Sahlgrenska Academy, University of Gothenburg, Gothenburg, S
相关性: 该论文研究了钛植入体表面纳米形貌对骨整合的分子和细胞影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或LPBF制造。
边界: This paper does not cover LPBF fabrication, porous structure design, stress shielding, or mechanical testing (static or fatigue).
动机· 探究明确纳米形貌对体内骨整合的分子和细胞机制。
方法· 采用胶体光刻在钛植入体上制备纳米突起，植入大鼠胫骨后分析。
结果· 纳米形貌植入体降低了炎症反应并增强了矿化。
验证· 大鼠体内植入后组织学、基因表达和元素分析验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To elucidate the in vivo molecular and cellular mechanisms by which well-defined nanotopography influences osseointegration.
Method· Colloidal lithography was used to fabricate semispherical nanotopography on titanium implants, which were implanted in rat tibiae and analyzed at multiple time points.
Result· Nanopatterned implants reduced inflammatory cytokine and osteoclastic marker expression while enhancing osteogenic activity and mineralization.
Validation· In vivo animal study with histology, qPCR, immunohistochemistry, and EDS analysis of retrieved implants.

A sequential Monte Carlo approach to Thompson sampling for Bayesian optimization

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Skim only numerical_benchmark UQ
Hildo Bijl, Thomas B. Schön, Jan-Willem van Wingerden, Michel Verhaegen arXiv preprint 2016-04-01 link
相关性: 提供贝叶斯优化中采样效率改进方法，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in the context of implant or biomechanics design.
动机· 贝叶斯优化中最大值的分布难以解析计算
方法· 用顺序蒙特卡洛采样近似高斯过程的最大值分布
结果· 无需优化采集函数，即可实现连续空间的汤普森采样

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To efficiently sample from the posterior distribution of the maximum of a Gaussian process for Bayesian optimization.
Method· Proposes a sequential Monte Carlo algorithm to approximate the distribution of the GP maximum, enabling Thompson sampling without optimizing an acquisition function.
Result· The method achieves competitive cumulative regret on continuous optimization benchmarks.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks comparing cumulative regret against standard Bayesian optimization methods.

Motivation· To develop a probabilistic model updating strategy that uses incomplete modal data without requiring mode matching.

Result· The proposed method successfully updates the model and quantifies uncertainty using only incomplete modal data.
Validation· The algorithm is validated through an experimental structural dynamics example.

Munenori Yasutake, Shinichiro Kuroshima, Takuya Ishimoto, Takayoshi Nakano, Takashi Sawase Implant dentistry 2016-04-01 10.1097/ID.0000000000000384
单位: *Postgraduate Student, Department of Applied Prosthodontics, Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences, Nagasaki University, Nagasaki, Japan. †These authors contributed equally to this work. ‡Assistant P
相关性: 该论文研究植入物颈部沟槽设计对骨整合的影响，但与AM生物医学材料方向（LPBF、多孔结构、应力屏蔽）无直接关联。
边界: Does not involve LPBF fabrication, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or as-built surface morphology; focuses on machined implant neck groove design in an animal model.
动机· 探究植入物颈部沟槽设计对机械加载下骨整合的影响。
方法· 在兔胫骨植入带不同角度沟槽的钛合金植入物，施加重复加载后使用组织形态学和微CT分析。

Motivation· To investigate how implant neck groove design affects osseointegration under mechanical loading in vivo.
Method· Anodized Ti-6Al-4V implants with +60° or -60° neck grooves were placed in rabbit tibiae and subjected to repetitive axial loading for 8 weeks, followed by histomorphometric and microCT analysis.
Result· Implants with +60° grooves showed superior osseointegration and bone formation under loaded conditions compared to -60° grooves.
Validation· In vivo rabbit model with controlled mechanical loading and quantitative imaging/histology.

Motivation· To evaluate the effect of crestal vs. subcrestal placement of narrow-diameter implants on osseointegration in severely atrophic alveolar ridges.
Method· Two types of narrow implants (MiniSky and NarrowSky) were placed at crestal and subcrestal levels in healing bone of atrophic ridges in six foxhounds, followed by histological and histomorphometric analysis at 4 and 8 weeks.
Result· Subcrestal placement yielded significantly higher bone-to-implant contact (BIC) than crestal placement, and implant design influenced crestal bone maintenance and peri-implant mucosa dimensions.

Motivation· To compare the survival rate and alveolar bone levels of implants loaded immediately versus after a 3-month healing period in the posterior maxilla.
Method· A prospective randomized controlled multicenter clinical trial with 30 patients and 71 implants, where test implants were immediately loaded with temporary restorations and controls received final restorations after 3 months.
Result· Over a 3-year follow-up, no significant differences in survival rates or radiographic bone levels were observed between immediately loaded and conventionally loaded implants.
Validation· Validation was performed through clinical examination and radiographic bone level measurements at annual intervals over 3 years.

Motivation· To test whether marginal bone-level alterations around loaded zirconia dental implants are similar to those around grade 4 titanium implants.
Method· In six dogs, three zirconia and one titanium implant type were placed in each hemimandible, restored with CAD/CAM crowns after six months, and sacrificed six months post-loading for radiographic bone level analysis.
Result· Zirconia implants exhibited higher fracture rates and significant differences in marginal bone loss compared to titanium implants during the 12-month study.
Validation· The study used an in vivo dog model with radiographic follow-up to assess bone-level changes.

Motivation· To evaluate the viability and safety of dental implants placed in irradiated bone in head and neck cancer patients.
Method· A systematic review of 8 publications involving 331 patients and 1237 implants was conducted to analyze failure rates and influencing factors.
Result· The overall implant failure rate was 9.53%, and neither the time interval between radiotherapy and implantation nor radiation dose was significantly associated with failure.
Validation· Clinical data from multiple studies were aggregated and analyzed.

Method· A retrospective cohort study analyzing health claims data from 9,525 patients who underwent elective unilateral THA.

Validation· Statistical analysis of a large administrative database without experimental or biomechanical validation.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To define risk factors, characteristics, and chronology of periprosthetic femoral fractures in revision total hip arthroplasty.
Method· Retrospective review of 5417 revision THAs from a prospectively collected database, classifying fractures by Vancouver system.
Result· Intra-operative fracture incidence was 12%, three times higher with uncemented stems; postoperative fracture probability at 20 years was 11%.
Validation· Large clinical database retrospective analysis.

Motivation· To compare clinical outcomes of salvage total hip arthroplasty after failed internal fixation versus primary arthroplasty for femoral neck fractures.
Method· A PRISMA-compliant systematic review and meta-analysis of studies from PubMed, EMBASE, and Cochrane libraries.
Result· Salvage THA showed significantly higher risks of deep infection, early dislocation, and periprosthetic fracture, but functional outcomes (EQ-5D) were not significantly different.
Validation· Meta-analysis of existing clinical studies, no experimental or biomechanical validation.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To quantify the contributions of clearance and creep to femoral head penetration in acetabular wear measurements.
Method· CT scans from 15 patients at day five post-THA and in vitro samples of three cup designs were analyzed to measure penetration.
Result· All-PE cups showed lower penetration than metal-backed and dual-mobility cups, with clearance and creep accounting for 0.15-0.46 mm and 0.05-0.27 mm respectively.
Validation· Clinical CT measurements were compared with in vitro sample measurements.
